name: minishogi4
description: This is a 4x4 Minishogi game where you can play against a "Perfect AI" that plays optimally using a pre-computed endgame database. The application runs on Cloudflare Pages with Cloudflare D1 for the database.

scripts.pages:dev: cp wrangler.public.toml wrangler.toml && npx wrangler pages dev .
scripts.pages:deploy: cp wrangler.private.toml wrangler.toml && npx wrangler pages deploy ./dist --commit-message=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
